reasoning: This is an automated customer support triage system for FairTix, a fair ticket marketplace. The workflow processes incoming support emails every minute, classifies them using AI into specific categories (FAQ, Account/Verification, Payment/Billing, Technical/Bug, Resale/Transfer, Feedback) with sentiment analysis. If classified as FAQ, it automatically generates and sends responses using company knowledge from Google Docs. Non-FAQ messages trigger manual notifications to the support team. All interactions are logged to Google Sheets for tracking. The 'DL-School-Automations Gmail' credential suggests this is an educational/demo implementation, but the sophisticated classification taxonomy and FAQ automation reveal a production-ready customer support capability.
name: FairTix AI Customer Support Triage System
businessNarrative: This workflow automates FairTix's first-line customer support by intelligently triaging incoming emails and providing instant FAQ responses. For a ticket marketplace where timing matters (queues, purchase windows, event dates), this enables 24/7 immediate responses to common questions while ensuring complex issues reach human agents with proper context and urgency classification. The detailed sentiment tracking and comprehensive logging suggest this is part of a larger customer experience optimization strategy.
trigger: Every minute, check for new support emails
dataFlow: Support emails enter via Gmail filter, get classified by Claude AI with sentiment analysis, FAQ responses auto-generated from Google Docs knowledge base and sent back, all interactions logged to Google Sheets tracking database, non-FAQ issues escalated to human support team

impact.reasoning: Customer-facing support automation that directly affects user experience and satisfaction. Failure means support requests go unanswered, customers can't get help with time-sensitive issues (queues, purchases), and support team loses visibility into incoming volume. However, manual fallback exists via direct email to support team.
impact.failureScenario: Support emails pile up unprocessed, customers receive no responses to FAQ queries, support team unaware of incoming volume and sentiment trends, potential revenue loss from unresolved purchase/payment issues
impact.revenueConnection: Indirect - poor support experience affects customer retention and word-of-mouth for ticket marketplace, but doesn't directly block transactions
